what: A giant letter strip filling the panel (the vertical strip has letters laid down at .9 of the width, the horizontal strip at .9 of the height) flows endlessly at .02 per second in strip-length units, and rolling the wheel speeds it up and cools it with damping 12, targeting one frame’s deltaY × 5e-5 ÷ frame length (±2). Moving the mouse splits the panel into 5×5 cells and the strip is pushed separately per cell (panel uv movement × 10 piled into cells within radius .22 and cooled by .965 every frame, push 1 = Shifts out of place like a block (3% of the band) then slowly returns to position

options.text: Text for the band (aria-label if none). Weight 900 · --kf-font-display
options.dir: vertical (default, letters laid sideways flowing up and down) · horizontal
options.speed: Band flow per second in band-length units, default .02 — 0 means it moves only by wheel or mouse
options.zoom: Band thickness / panel width (vertical) · height (horizontal), default .9
options.gap: Letter spacing / average character width, default .025
options.wheel: At 0, wheel and drag don’t speed it up
options.hover: If 0, the mouse won’t knock cells out of alignment
options.color: Band color skin variable name, default --kf-ink

use: <section data-fx="block-warp-strip" data-fx-block-warp-strip="text: ABC; color: --kf-ink" style="height: 100svh">…Text to overlay…</section> — three loads this folder’s three-global.js before library/_vendor/three@0.180.0/build/three.cjs and receives it as window.THREE. The band is the rearmost canvas of the sheet, so other text on the sheet is layered above it with position

from.where: index.html logo strip behind the hero (.gl-canvas) — original main.js marquee class (three r180 plane · baseSpeed .02 · zoom .9 · wheel 5e-5·±2·damping 12 · GPGPU 5×5 grid radius .22·×10·.965 · UV_STRENGTH .03 · letter gap .025), about.html header horizontal strip (no scroll · hover)

note: Instead of the original logo image, the band is drawn with skin typeface letters. The mouse is measured in panel uv wherever it moves in the window and accumulated (whole-window grid like the original). Stops when off screen. On touch, cell shifting is off and only dragging is accepted, like a wheel (taps are not intercepted)
